|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-20-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]] (original, release sheet of 14 September 2012); [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 12 December 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 4, slip 20 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). [Immune to Alter]” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 21)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21, page 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21 Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 (this page); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]], the same words). The same text was shown earlier as one of the four Virtual Block 8.2 preview cards (posted 14 July 2012, legal from 26 July 2012)<ref name="pc-news-82preview">Players Committee news post “v8.2 Preview Spoiler List”, 14 July 2012 (“spoiled cards are always subject to change prior to release”), on the News page as captured 18 August 2012: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111414/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown from 12 December 2012, the first archived capture with Virtual Block 8.2 text, to 11 January 2013) writes “Gone: treat '4' on it as '2'.” and “(an/or their matching weapon_” (typos as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1282_20">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VBlock8Name / VBlock8Rarity list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]: treat "4" on it as "2". Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (an/or their matching weapon_. [Immune to Alter]” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list writes quotations in single quotes (its HTML cannot hold double quotes); double quotes are used here, with the card list's punctuation. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 21)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-20-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-aremoteplanet-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
